capabilities_done: Session latency compensation: track latency = sum of its stage latencies (<= MAX_TRACK_LATENCY 2^24); the stack is primed with timeline samples 0..L (outputs discarded) and then fed L samples ahead, so output frame t carries timeline t for every track (session latency 0, track_latency() reports L); stage k lanes are evaluated at the timeline time of the audio it reads (n - latency of earlier stages); tested bit-exact against dry tracks (two transparent lookahead stages, ClickRepair 1792) and against the stages run by hand shifted by their latency with a threshold step, across block partitions down to 1 frame and after reset()

Per-track effect stacks: TrackSpec (non-exhaustive, TrackSpec::new) holds effects: Vec<EffectSlot{processor, lanes}> (<= MAX_TRACK_EFFECTS 16); every stage must accept the clip layout and the session rate; Automatable::automation_parameters now returns a Vec (rate-dependent ranges possible, called outside the audio path); SidechainDynamics (threshold/ratio/makeup) and ClickRepair (threshold) are Automatable

Automatable for every processor: Gain, Pan, ChannelMix, HardLimiter, LookaheadLimiter, Equalizer (master + per-section frequency/gain/q, rate-dependent range), RampedGain (target), Dynamics, SidechainDynamics, MultibandCompressor (3 per band), FeedbackDelay, Flanger, Chorus (delay+depth bounded by the line sized at construction), Phaser (min <= max < rate/2), ClickRepair, HumRemover (notches re-placed), Reverb (comb gains recomputed), NoiseReducer; Unity, LoudnessMeter and Chain expose none (Chain stages are type-erased; a session track automates stages through its own stack); construction-time sizes (delay times, FFT, voices, stages, bands, lookahead) are not automatable. Proven: for all 59 parameters, set_automated on a fresh processor is bit-identical to constructing with the value and audible on the test input (except a low-pass section's gain, ignored by definition); NaN/inf/out-of-range/unknown index refused and leave the processor unchanged; a linear ramp on every parameter through a Session renders finite and bit-identical across block partitions
